title: Rory and the Pillow Fern Hollow
verses:
The sun dipped away as the evening grew still,
And shadows rolled down to the velvet-green hill.
Then Rory stepped out in the lavender light,
To welcome the quiet and slumber of night.

Beside him walked Tilly with slow, steady feet,
Where blossoms of clover smelled tender and sweet.
While Benny leaned down with a hum and a sigh,
And watched the pale moon climbing into the sky.

Then Ricky stopped skipping to sit in the shade,
Along the cool moss of the quietest glade.
And Nia came gliding on wings wide and slow,
To circle above where the night-petals glow.

Now Psittaco chirped from a nest in the pine,
Where needles were soft and the breezes were fine.
She tucked in her feathers and settled her head,
To show all the others the way to their bed.

Then Rory lay down where the clover was deep,
And yawned as he waited for comfort and sleep.
While Benny and Tilly curled close for their rest,
Like birds finding peace in a welcoming nest.

The stars twinkled soft in a blanket of blue,
And fern fronds were kissed by the silvery dew.
With heavy eyes closing and drifting away,
Now Rory was dreaming till dawn brought the day.
